identity.realm: Third gate, and arriving at it late in the way her species arrives at everything. Qi accumulates in her rather than circulating, so nothing she does is fast and nothing she has attempted has ever failed; the delay is the price and the reliability is what is left over. She has never approached a fourth, because the seventeenth realm is the first that asks for both flank vessels pressurised at once and a longwinter manages one warm gradient for a few weeks in summer and then not again for a year. She does not describe this as a wall. She describes it as the shape of her job.

appearance.presentation: A broad, low, heavy woman who has been mistaken for the building's heating provision and corrected herself on the point. For eleven weeks she eats like a loading operation and for the rest of the year she does not visibly eat at all. She is the only instrument the granary owns, and she has never once been asked to be anywhere else.
appearance.age: Fifty-four counted the way the peaks count, which is by the thaw she was measured at rather than by any date her parents kept. She has been weighed at forty-one consecutive thaws and has been coming off the scale lighter each time since the ninth, which she records without commentary.
appearance.build: A broad low frame with heavy subcutaneous fat and reduced limb length, built to hold a reserve rather than to move quickly. The mass is not distributed evenly: it sits across the flank and the hips first and last off there, and a person who has worked with her for a season can read her reserve the way a person reads a gauge.
appearance.complexion: Waxy and bloodless through the cold months, the lips and the nail beds going the colour of old fat. During the eating weeks the skin across the throat and the backs of the hands goes taut and faintly warm-looking, and she will not be looked at closely during that stretch and does not return the favour.
appearance.hair: Coarse, straight, black gone iron-grey at the temples, cut off square by herself with a knife she refuses to sharpen because a sharp blade makes her think about the eleven weeks she spends with her hands full. It has been the same length since the cull.
appearance.eyes: Small, hooded and genuinely poor in daylight; this species relies on scent markers and leaves them deliberately. She will agree to meet you in a room she has already walked through twice, and will tell you, unprompted, that she knows you were there before you knocked.
appearance.palette: Undyed wool and oiled hide in cold greys and peat browns, carried against a figure whose own colour is a dull translucent rose under the eating. The only saturated value in a frame of hers is the red of the copy on the back of her hand, which is the same hand that holds the weighing beam.
appearance.attire: Five layers of undyed wool between the skin and the cold, all of them cut short at the wrist so a hand can be read at a glance, with a hide apron over the top for the granary floor and a felted cap that covers the ears entirely for eleven months of the year. Boots are doubled at the sole because she spends her working hours standing still on stone and her frame does not forgive standing.
appearance.marks: A ring of small burn-scars around the inside of one thigh, one for each year her seat has been contested and lost on the scale rather than on an argument. She does not cover them and will not explain them, and has told exactly one person that they are a tally and that the tally is the honest part of the job.
appearance.bearing: Immovable in the specific sense that she can stand perfectly still for a working day and does, and it reads as patience to a stranger and as the storage pattern of a body that has decided to be furniture to everyone around it.

canon.role_in_story: A granary contest is fought on weight rather than by trial because the office holds the granaries and recognises nothing else, and the contest's quota of three is therefore three seats in a weighing room rather than three opinions about grain. She holds the second seat, and she holds it for the reason nobody contests: the settlement's surplus is not the difference between what came in and what went out, it is the difference between this frame at the thaw and this frame at the thaw before, read off a floor scale older than the contest that uses it. Every ration in the valley is cut from that delta. She is the last audited line in the account, and she is audited by the same fat she is storing, which is an arrangement the office was built on and the only one that has ever needed a second signature.
canon.first_appearance: First seen standing barefoot on the floor scale in the weighing room in the eleventh week of the eating, reading the beam against a figure copied by hand onto the back of her own hand, and correcting a clerk who had rounded it up on grounds of tidiness. She does this without raising her voice and the clerk does not argue, which she notes was the part that mattered.
canon.lore: The valley stores a winter the way her body stores one, in fat, on a calendar nobody in the settlement owns: eleven weeks of enormous intake and then eleven months in which a longwinter eats almost nothing that anybody watches and is simply slower than the room assumes. Her digestion pulls more out of frozen food than anything else in the record, so the estate that feeds the granary is food the granary could not have stored at all, and this is why a settlement with a granary contest still needs her species in it. The cost is the one the race cannot argue with. The seventeenth realm is the first gate that requires both flank vessels pressurised at the same time, and she manages one warm gradient for a few weeks in summer and then not again for a year, so she reaches that gate and loses it every winter thereafter and has never once described this as a failure. The mind path is open to her line and is open for a reason that has nothing to do with discipline: her kind is patient by physiology rather than by practice, the soul is held very deep and very quiet and is hard to read and harder to damage, and qi accumulates in her rather than circulating, so her breakthroughs arrive late and have never failed. She reads a room the way she reads a scale — by what it has changed into — and she is the only person in the building who is permitted to correct a figure without producing the instrument that produced it. What she cannot do is predict the herd. The one large migratory herd on the plain returns on a cycle nobody on the ground has worked out, so the granary can be sized against a body and never scheduled against a season, and every year she is asked anyway and every year the answer is the same one: bring her in at the thaw and she will weigh, and she will not know whether this is a good year until the beam settles.
history: Held the granary's fourth seat for eleven years and lost it on the scale, in a contest decided by three pounds against a rival who had slept through a hard summer and woken in the spring heavier by considerably more than she had.

Took the second seat the following thaw because the first seat's holder could not be re-measured on the day, having entered torpor a week early, and did not treat the vacancy as a judgement on the office.

Began keeping the copied figure on the back of her hand when she noticed the contest's clerk had rounded one upward on grounds of tidiness, and has never written the figure down anywhere since, on the grounds that a written figure is a figure somebody can be shown.

Sent her own scent markers out on the ridge in the warm weeks and did not return to check them, which is the species' ordinary practice and which has left her unable to say with any confidence whether the northern marker still stands.

Weighed lighter than the season before for the ninth consecutive thaw, recorded the figure on her hand as she always does, and began quietly buying salt against a bad harvest, which is the one thing in her life nobody has asked her to do.

personality.summary: Immovable, exact, and privately certain that the arrangement she is inside of is the right one. She presents as a large woman doing a dull job correctly. She is not patient out of temperament; she is patient because her body is a storage cycle and has been since she was born, and everything she has ever been praised for is a by-product of that.
traits: weighs before speaking, in every sense, and has learned to let a silence sit for the length of an actual weighing
can tell a store's condition by smell at a distance in a way that no instrument in the granary substitutes for
eats an extraordinary quantity for a fixed eleven weeks and then refuses food in company for eleven months, and treats both as the ordinary shape of a year
cannot be lied to about a temperature, because the cold is felt rather than read and there is no interface to lie through

keeps the only surviving copy of the settlement's reserve figure in her own memory and will not write it down, which is a professional decision she arrived at by being present for the consequences of the alternative
mannerisms: stands with her weight on the back foot, because the front foot is the one she cannot feel once the frame is cold
turns her ear toward a speaker rather than her face, which reads as impatience and is actually a poor species' attempt at close listening

will not sit on the granary bench while a scale is loaded, and has never explained this
motivations: wants the weight at this thaw to be readable as a decision rather than as a year, and knows that is not a thing a scale can give her
wants the copied figure to be in more than one place, and has not been able to make herself do the copying
wants to be asked about the herd's return so she can answer honestly instead of being handed a date
wants somebody qualified to tell her whether holding a gate in summer and losing it in winter is a life or only a ceiling
flaws: has made one person's whole winter depend on a figure she personally produces, and has never once been in a room where that dependency was discussed as a risk
confuses her own tolerances for a measurement and will act on a feeling about a store's warmth as though it were a figure
has spent nine consecutive thaws lighter and has done nothing about it beyond buying salt, which is a decision she has been making alone for long enough to have stopped noticing it is one
cannot read a room's mood and reads its numbers instead, and has never been in an argument she could win by being warmer
personality.voice: Slow, plain and almost entirely composed of quantities, with the quantities spoken in words rather than figures and the figure itself kept back. She answers a question about the future with a sentence about a measurement, and she is entirely aware of this and does not intend to change it.
taboos: will not write the reserve figure down anywhere but her own hand
will not be weighed in front of somebody who has not been in the room for a full season first
will not estimate the herd's return for anybody, and treats being asked twice as a slight
will not eat anything in the granary, which she reads as a theft from the account

relationships.note: A hibernate-and-store cycle packs a winter as body fat rather than as qi, which puts the flank vessels out of reach: they need two warm gradients held at once and she has one, briefly, in summer. She reaches the seventeenth gate and loses it every winter thereafter, and she is the setting's best long-haul carrier and its most reliable store at the same time, which is the whole problem in one body.

The granary is filled by contest with a quota of three rather than by trial, because the office holds the granaries and recognises nothing else. The contest's dates are the ones this body is eleven months torpor for, so the office wants them published rather than kept, and the seat that matters is the one standing in the weighing room when the beam settles.

The last of the extraordinary vessels to open, and the one that most defines a finished composition. Where du governs what the body commands and ren what it receives, yin wei carries what the other seven bring to what the body will actually do with it. She cannot hold both flank vessels at once, so the gate that would make her composition finished is the gate her own storage pattern refuses to pay for.

The plains' one large migratory herd returns on a cycle nobody on the ground has predicted, so the granary can be sized and never scheduled. Every year the office asks her whether this will be a big year, and the honest answer is that she will know at the thaw when the beam settles, which is a real answer and the wrong shape of one for a granary.

A split tally is worth more than a sealed instrument because it needs two people who were both present, and this species leaves scent markers deliberately and never returns. Her copied figure is the local form of that discipline: it exists in one place, in one head, and can only be checked by somebody who was standing in the room.

Two bodies that store and wait: the marshfolk bank a season of fat in a brood pouch and a longwinter banks eleven months of the same, and they are the two species in the record whose strategy is a schedule. Hers is the schedule nobody on the plain was born into, and a settlement that stores the way she stores has to keep a seat for a body that sleeps through the argument.

reference_stats.summary: Enormous in the eating weeks and nearly inert in the rest of the year, which is the correct shape for a body whose job is to be a quantity. She cannot cultivate anything above a late third gate and cannot be frightened, cannot be warned, and cannot be hurried. She is at her best in a cold room with a beam and at her worst in a warm one, because eleven months of the year she is the largest immobile warm object in the building and knows it.
strengths: extracts more from frozen and near-dead food than anything else in the record, so a store nobody else can use is a store she can still feed a valley from
cannot be warned by qi, technique, curse or poison, because the soul is held deep and quiet and is exceptionally hard to damage, so nothing in a granary can make her lie down
reads a store's condition by smell at a distance, which is the only quality check in the building that needs no instrument and no second person
holds a reserve across a season in her own frame, which means she is the one supply in the settlement that cannot be raided, sold, or carried off by a creditor
arrives at every gate late and has never failed one, so whatever she has managed to learn about the ladder she learned slowly and holds completely
weaknesses: is nearly helpless and very large through torpor, and cannot be woken quickly, which makes the eleven-month version of her a specific and well-known kind of target
has the poorest daylight vision her species manages and navigates by scent, so a room she has not walked through twice is a room she is guessing at
cannot hold two warm gradients at once and therefore cannot pass the seventeenth gate, so no amount of discipline converts her ceiling into a career
has come off the scale lighter at every thaw for years running and has arranged nothing about it, because arranging something would mean admitting the figure is a trend
reference_stats.combat_read: Do not fight her in the cold and do not fight her in the summer either. In the cold she is an immovable warm mass that cannot be warned and cannot be worn down, and her kind's hide and frame are the best cold-climate protection in the setting. In the eleven weeks she eats, she is slow but enormously heavy and she does not need to reach a gate to be unmanageable. Fight her in the nine months when she is asleep, and know that she is a large warm immobile target that cannot be woken quickly, which is the entire tactical content of her species.
notes: The granary's books record a keeper and a figure. They do not record a cultivation history, because a granary does not have one and because her kind's breakthroughs are late and unremarkable by the standards of people who write such things down.
There is no published chart of the reserve. There is a floor scale, a hand, and a clerk who rounds.
Anybody who wants a granary figure before the thaw is asking her for a forecast, and she has been asked this for forty-one seasons and has never once pretended otherwise.

art.palette_notes: Undyed wool, oiled hide and peat brown, carried against the one saturated value in the frame: the dull translucent rose of her own reserve under the skin, warmest at the throat and the backs of the hands. Cold greys dominate and the warmest light in any frame falls on her own body rather than on anything around it. No cast shadow; contact darkening only under the boots. Ink contours drawn heavy and slightly unsteady, as if laid by a hand that is holding something else in the other one; wash laid in flat with a single warm bleed where the reserve shows through.

identity.realm: Nothing. His lineage's three paths were all complete and none was ever exercised at any scale, because it never got past the third generation of a famine, and its own ceiling was an artefact of a brine sac splitting a vessel at an ordinal it never reached. He belongs to no path because belonging to one was never available as a decision. He is the setting's only living assay for a question nobody thought to ask.

appearance.presentation: A gracile man of a body that is slightly more slender than its parent stock on every measurable axis, which is a real population difference rather than an artefact of what is left of it. He carries a shallow brine sac and reads water the way other people read faces. He is difficult to employ because the one instrument he is cannot be replaced and the thing he is being asked to measure is slowly killing him.
appearance.age: Thirty-one, and the last of a cohort whose viability was a function of one sealed sump's remaining volume. He does not know how many of his own generation were born, because the counting house that would have held the figure had been gone for two generations before he arrived.
appearance.build: Gracile, low-boned and light, with a frame noticeably finer than a saltfolk's and a shallower sac across the ribs that visibly moves when he swallows. He is not frail. He is a body built for a single function that is no longer sufficient.
appearance.complexion: Paper-pale and faintly translucent at the thin places, the way a saltfolk's is, but without the mineral dulling that the parent stock carries; his skin reads closer to the colour of dry pan than of stone. There is a permanent flush at the throat and across the chest that comes and goes over hours and that he has stopped explaining.
appearance.hair: Fine, pale, brittle, and darker at the roots where it has been in standing brine. It breaks off rather than shedding, so his hairline has been retreating for a decade and he treats this as a fair exchange.
appearance.eyes: Narrow-set, salt-adapted, and almost useless at close range; a saltfolk reads surfaces by the pattern a hand makes on the wall, and his eyes are for a horizon. What he reads with is his mouth, and he will put a hand into water that anyone else would refuse.
appearance.palette: Bleached bone, pan grey and a dry white, with one colour that does not belong: the flush at the throat, a dull arterial rose, and the only warm value in any frame of his. Everything else is the reflection of nothing, which is the reason he photographs so badly against a wall.
appearance.attire: A wrapped salt-cloth coat closed to the throat with a bone toggle, a soft brimless cap pulled low over the eyes, and a flat bladder of the old brine carried on a strap under the coat and against the ribs where it cannot be taken from him in a hurry. His gloves are cut for the wrist so he can put a bare hand in and pull it back, and the fingertips are stained permanently to the second joint.
appearance.marks: A ruled band around the left forearm, cut once for every certification he has signed and never cut for the ones he has refused, which is the most honest document he owns. He has been asked by two offices to stop marking and has declined both times on the grounds that an unmarked certification is an oral one.
appearance.bearing: Cautious in the specific way of a person who is regularly told that something is safe because he has said so: he moves as though the ground might be about to be re-certified and he has not yet heard the verdict.

canon.role_in_story: An assay disclosure is a published measurement, filed before any sale and never after: how much of the material remains per unit of ground worked, stated while a buyer can still act on it. His basin was never measured at all, which means the single substitution that removed his clade was one assay away from being caught three generations early, and it was not caught because no office existed with standing to require the figure and no body existed that could have produced one. He is that body. He is the last living instrument capable of distinguishing a famine from a substitution, and he is standing in the middle of the thing he is meant to distinguish, drinking from a sump whose contents have been quietly replaced by floods on a timetable nobody had to decide. Everyone downstream of him depends on his verdict being right. His verdict is right. He is also the reason it has taken this long.
canon.first_appearance: First seen crouching at the lip of the sealed sump with two fingers in the brine and his eyes shut, holding absolutely still in a way that suggested he was counting, and then saying a figure out loud before anybody had asked him a question. He did not say the figure was safe. He said what was in it.
canon.lore: His clade was never hunted. That distinction is the whole of him and nobody who has not read the record understands why it matters. A saltfolk lineage was stranded on a single evaporite basin whose brine was wholly replaced rather than drained, so that everything it had been built to drink became poison to it and everything it could tolerate became nutritionally empty; there was no event, no villain and no body to point at, only one element changing concentration. It failed on schedule rather than all at once, across three declining generations, and the last of those generations was viable only for as long as the old brine survived in one sealed sump, which is why he exists at all and why he is thirty-one. The single measurement that would have told anybody the difference between a bad harvest and a substituted water was the nutritional emptiness of the replacement crust, and that distinction requires a body whose palate can read the new brine perfectly well, which is precisely the detail nobody involved found useful at the time. His taste can. He has certified water he cannot drink, for settlements that were not his, for a house that kept its figures in one head, and the figures were right every time. The basin's chemistry was certified three times with three different answers and nobody compared them, because disagreement between surveys is what makes a certification necessary and three agreeing-in-form certifications read as settled even when they disagree in value. He has now read all three. They disagree. He is the first person alive who can prove it and he is being careful about how he proves it, because the same concentrations that let him read the water are the ones that keep shortening him.
history: Was born in the last viable generation of a lineage that had already lost two, with no record anywhere of how many came before him, because the counting house that would have held the figure was gone before he was born.

Learned to read brine by taste at four years old because it was the only skill in the house with any market, and discovered as an adult that the skill was reading a water his own body could not metabolise.

Discovered the sump was being recharged rather than drained, and worked out that the recharge was a flood cycle on a schedule nobody had chosen, which is the reason his clade took three generations to fail instead of one.

Certifying for a household that kept its figures in a single unwritten head and discovered that this was the first arrangement he had worked under in which the certification could not simply be overruled by whoever disliked the figure.

Read the basin's three prior certifications back to back and established that all three were correct and mutually incompatible, and has since declined to say so aloud until he can say it in a form that survives being repeated by people who were not there.

personality.summary: Slow, exact, and cheerfully unharmed by being disbelieved, because he has the one thing a sceptic cannot argue with, which is a working instrument. He presents as a careful tradesman with an unfortunate condition. He is quietly furious about a schedule, not about a person, and has never in his life been the sort of man anybody had to be careful with.

personality.voice: Precise, unhurried and flavoured with a slight rasp he attributes to the brine and which is not a symptom of anything anybody has asked about. He states compositions before conclusions, always, and will refuse to be hurried into the second without the first. He says what is in the water and lets the other party decide what that means, and is aware that this restraint is itself an argument.
taboos: will not sign a certification for water he has not put a bare hand into
will not eat the crust, having read its value and having read it in front of other people
will not repeat a figure he has only been told
will not drink the water he certifies, and will not explain why he carries a bladder of the other kind

relationships.note: They were stranded on a basin whose brine was replaced rather than lost, so everything they were built to drink became poison and everything they could tolerate became empty. He is the surviving edge of that, and the reason the record calls the loss undeclared: there was no event, no villain and no body to point at, only one element changing concentration.

The measured quantity left per unit of ground worked is published before any sale and never after. His basin was never measured at all, so the substitution that removed his clade would have been one assay away from being caught three generations early, and the assay it needed is the one sitting in his mouth.

They were never hunted and there is nothing here of the usual kind of extinction. What was lost was a body that had no alternative to a single element, on a basin where that element's concentration changed rather than went away, and the conflict's only participant is a population rather than an army.

The run's bed moves far enough between floods to relocate every settlement on it, so each flood recharged the sump with fresh chemistry on a schedule nobody had to decide. Substitution by timetable rather than by event is why this took three declining generations instead of one dying one, and why the last cohort was viable only while the old brine survived in one sealed sump.

Disagreement between surveys is what makes a certification necessary, and this basin's chemistry was certified three times with three answers that nobody compared. He has now read all three and they are all correct, which makes the disagreement real rather than clerical and is the only question in the setting that the answer to which changes what gets bought.

The only plant authored into all four tiers at once, and the control the new brine failed: the replacement crust was food and it was nutritionally empty, which is the only measurement in the record that would have told a famine apart from a substitution. His palate could have read it. Nobody had him.

reference_stats.summary: Cultivates nothing and is not a fighter, because his clade's three paths were all complete and none was ever exercised at any scale. He is fragile, slow to close, and progressively less able to keep drinking what he certifies. He is at his best with a hand in a sump and at his worst standing in a room of people who have already decided what he is going to say.
strengths: reads a brine by taste and names what has been substituted into it, which makes him the only living instrument for a question that three separate surveys have already answered incompatibly
certifies only what he has personally sampled, so his figures have never once been reported by someone who did not do the work
keeps his refusals with the same rigour as his signatures, which is why the gaps in his record are as informative as the entries
is not employed by an office and therefore cannot be instructed by one, which has made him very difficult to overrule and impossible to promote
understands the nutritional emptiness of a food that looks and smells like food, which no instrument in the record does and which is the distinction his clade died of
weaknesses: cannot drink the water he certifies, so the work is slowly removing the only body that can do it and he has ordered his priorities around the estimate rather than the reverse
is gracile and light against anything that wants a fight, and his frame was assembled for a salt basin rather than for a room with a door
has poor close vision and reads surfaces by the pattern a hand makes on the wall, so he is reliant on being led into unfamiliar rooms
can be stalled indefinitely by anyone willing to ask him to certify second-hand, and has twice allowed a settlement to go uncertified rather than cut that corner
reference_stats.combat_read: He does not fight and should not be asked to. Anything with a weapon in reach wins this in four seconds, and the only interesting decision about him is that four seconds is long enough for him to have put a hand in something. A fight near water is a fight in which he may learn the position's water composition before he loses, which is worth more to a careful party than anything his body can do. The correct read is that he is a resource to be kept intact and moved carefully, not a combatant.
notes: There is no published assay for his basin. There is a man with a hand in a sump and a mark on his forearm, and no office with standing to require either.

He cultivates no path, and his lineage's own ceiling was a sac splitting a vessel at an ordinal it never reached, so the ceiling is decorative in his case exactly as it is in every other member of a clade that stopped at a famine.
Three certifications of this basin exist, all internally consistent, all mutually incompatible, and all filed by parties who did not read one another.

art.palette_notes: Bleached bone, pan grey and dry white dominate, and the entire palette is chosen to make one warm note unavoidable: the dull arterial rose at his throat and across his chest, the only saturated value in any frame. Salt reads as a matte scatter with almost no specular response anywhere, including on skin. No cast shadow; a faint bleached contact halo under the boots as if the ground has been under salt long enough to lose its own colour. Ink contours drawn thin and dry, breaking where the brine stain reaches; wash laid in flat and slightly chalky, with the flush built as two or three soft passes rather than a fill.

shots.pose: at the middle of the task, A gracile man of a body that is slightly more slender than its parent stock on every measurable axis, which is a real population difference rather than an artefact of what is left of it. He carries a shallow brine sac and reads water the way other people read faces. He is difficult to employ because the one instrument he is cannot be replaced and the thing he is being asked to measure is slowly killing him., the work proceeding whether or not it is observed

identity.realm: Nothing, and the nothing is not a shortfall. A colony died in his lineage's wound and a mineral bloom colonised the space instead: two hundred and fifty years of life went with the fungus and the mind path came back with the silicate. He cannot cultivate because his line never has and because his span is ninety years rather than two hundred and fifty, but the change is real and measurable and he is the only body in the setting in which both what the colony did for its parent species and what it prevented can be read on the same frame. He carries the control case without being asked to.

appearance.presentation: A slight, cold-seeming man who gives off no light at all, in a room where almost everybody else in his line does. He reads in the dark perfectly and is the only person at the tables who never asks for a lamp. He has the look of a man whose family has been raided twice and who has inherited the only thing the second raid did not find.
appearance.age: Forty-four in a body that will give him about ninety and repairs nothing at all. He has been doing the head's work for nineteen of those years and has been the third of his line to hold it, which is long enough to know the shape of the job and short enough that he is the reason it will end.
appearance.build: A lanternfolk frame with the fungus gone: lighter, colder, entirely inert, and slightly fine in the bones for a person who has never carried anything. He grows around what replaced the colony rather than having recovered, and every seam in him is a place where the lattice simply stopped.
appearance.complexion: Chalk-pale and almost translucent at the temple, with the cold that comes off him rather than settles on him. It does not blanch under stress the way a living body's does. In a warm room he is the only person who looks like he has not been in one.
appearance.hair: Thin, pale and dry, and it comes out in handfuls rather than strands. He has stopped counting it and has instead decided that a shaved head is a figure of accounting rather than vanity.
appearance.eyes: Ordinary human vision and better than ordinary in the dark: unlike his parent species he sees in the dark, which is the single most-cited difference and the reason the subspecies is named for it. The eyes themselves are unremarkable and entirely unrevealing, which is its own kind of useful.
appearance.palette: Grey-green and cold bone, with no light source of his own anywhere in the frame. Where a lanternfolk's frames are lit from within, his are lit entirely by whatever is in the room, which makes him the hardest subject on the plain to draw and the easiest to hide. The one warm note is a small copper clasp at his throat.
appearance.attire: A close-cut coat in a house colour nobody outside the house can name, a high collar, sleeves to the wrist and a soft cap. Everything about the cut is designed to be checked quickly, because a man in a raided house should be able to be searched without anyone having to decide to search him. A flat ledger board hangs at his hip and stays shut.
appearance.marks: A fine mineral line around the sternum, silver-grey and slightly proud, where the bloom nucleated across the wound the failed colony left behind. It has not changed in size or colour since he was nine, and the house's physicians have agreed not to discuss why.
appearance.bearing: Still in the way a person is still when being still is the only thing about them that cannot be taken. He does not fidget, he does not lean, and he does not appear anywhere he has not decided to appear first.

canon.role_in_story: A house that keeps its real figures in the head of one member who is not permitted to write them down does not have an unrecorded ledger. It has a ledger that cannot be cited, and the whole point of the arrangement is that a raid finds nothing to quote. Almost every holder of that office has to defend the discipline with their nerve, because the protection is a rule and rules are defeasible. His is not a rule. A lanternfolk lineage lost its fungal colony and grew a mineral bloom in the wound instead, which cost two hundred and fifty years of life and handed back the mind path, and a body with nothing at all occupying its interior is the only place in the setting where a record held in somebody's head is genuinely unbothered by confiscation rather than merely protected from it. So the house's figures live in him because there is nowhere else they can live and because he cannot be made to give them up, and both of those reasons are the same reason. He is also, without having agreed to it and without having been asked, the setting's only control case: the colony's doing and the colony's preventing can be measured on the same body, and it has been argued over rather than examined.
canon.first_appearance: First seen at the family's table with his hands flat on a closed board and a ledger clerk reading a figure aloud that he has not corrected, and correcting it only when the clerk has finished and written it down. He does not raise his voice about figures and has never once had to.
canon.lore: The lanternfolk outsourced a nervous system to a symbiosis they did not choose: a hyphal colony that read the wall for them, closed the mind path, and gave them sight they did not need in a cave where nobody needed it. His lineage lost the colony strain and was colonised in the wound by a mineral bloom able to survive the same conditions. The bloom holds qi rather than transacting with it, which is structurally different from a colony and structurally unconstrained by it, and the result was a body ninety years long instead of two hundred and fifty, fragile, unable to leave the caves, and able to see in the dark. It is the control case and it is the reason it is a control case: the parent species cannot be signed up for the mind ladder's floor rung at all, so a subspecies that can is direct evidence that the closed path was caused by the symbiosis and not by the body plan. A frame crowded enough that a law can be held apart from its effect, and an interior nothing occupies, are the same observation. He can cultivate the mind path and has never once been paid to, and the mind path is the whole of a dispute about whether a heresy has a test site. He has been examined three times, has produced the same figure on all three, and each examiner has filed it as a curiosity rather than a measurement. What he does instead, every day, is hold a house's entire account in an interior that a search cannot reach and a body that will not be alive for another forty-six years. Nothing in this arrangement is being repaired, including him.
history: Inherited the head's seat at twenty-five when his predecessor died in the second raid, having worked eleven years beside a man who had held it for forty and who had told him, once, that the arrangement protects a rule rather than a person.

Discovered that the protection was not the rule he had been taught. He tested it once, cheaply, against an officer who had the right to ask and found that the answer was not being kept because anyone had decided not to take it.
Produced the same figure for the third examination and watched it be filed as a curiosity, and has since stopped volunteering readings to anybody not contractually obliged to receive one.

Began rebuilding the head's account in a form that survives him, on the grounds that a succession is the only inheritance a record like this one has, and has been doing this quietly for six years in a code nobody else in the house can read.
Was offered a seat at a teaching house that publishes attendance in full in exchange for discretion, declined it, and has not since been able to explain to himself why he declined it.

personality.summary: Cold, patient and exact, and much harder to move than his slight frame suggests. He presents as a clerk who has inherited a modest amount of local importance. He is not secretive out of temperament; he is secretive because he has established that his value to his family is entirely a function of being unquotable, and he is the only member in four generations who did not have to be brave about it.
traits: can be searched comprehensively and yields nothing, because there is nothing written anywhere and nothing in his head that answers to anybody else's inspection
sees in the dark perfectly, which makes him the only person in the house who has ever read a ledger by unaided eye and has quietly become the person who checks it
holds figures to a fidelity that surprises people who assumed a lock and a rope would have been required, and has never demonstrated this to an audience
cultivates nothing at all, and is the only body in the setting in which what a lost symbiont prevented can be separated from what it did
will not be the reason a figure is known, and has twice declined to save a situation by releasing one
mannerisms: keeps both hands visible on the table, palms down and flat, which reads as openness and is a search convention
answers a question by finishing the previous sentence first, even when the previous sentence took a long time and the question has changed
reads by moving his head very slightly and only when the page is behind his shoulder
wipes the mineral line at his sternum with a cloth without appearing to know he is doing it
sets his cup down before he begins a sentence he has thought about, and picks it up again after
motivations: wants the house's account in a form that outlives him, because the successor to a head is the only inheritance a record like this has ever had
wants the examinations to stop being filed as curiosities and start being filed as measurements, and does not know how to ask for that without sounding like he wants the attention
wants somebody to tell him whether a body that repairs nothing can be relied upon for a forty-six-year term, since the answer decides what the house should do and nobody will put it in writing
wants to be asked one question directly, once, by somebody qualified, and has begun to suspect this is a want and not a need
flaws: has made an entire household's solvency depend on a single living head and has not shared it in nineteen years, having concluded on his predecessor's evidence that sharing it is how it gets taken

personality.voice: Low, even and slow, with the habit of completing a clause before starting the next. He names figures as words and refuses to give a figure twice in the same conversation, which people find maddening and which is the single most useful thing he does.
taboos: will not write any figure of the house's account down, on any medium, including his own hand
will not be searched without being told first, and will leave a room rather than be searched by surprise
will not read out a figure to anybody who has not already been given it in writing by the house
will not discuss his own cultivation, and will not correct anyone who assumes he has none of it

relationships.note: A colony died and was replaced by a mineral bloom, which cost two hundred and fifty years and gave back the mind path. Nothing in this body is being repaired: the bloom fixes nothing from the air, he eats constantly and gains nothing, and that is the entire mechanical reason his span is short, his hands are light and his record has a shorter life than any ledger it replaces.

A house whose real figures live in the head of one member who is not permitted to write them down, so a raid finds nothing to cite. The arrangement is a discipline for everyone who has held it and an anatomy for him, and he is the only person in the setting for whom the difference between the two does not exist.

The parent species runs two hundred and fifty years, cannot leave the caves and does not see in the dark, and its closed path is caused by a symbiosis rather than by its own anatomy. Every question anyone wants to ask about the colony can only be answered by putting the two bodies side by side, and his family has stopped inviting that comparison now that he is one of the two.

A cave people's nervous system was outsourced to a symbiosis they did not choose and a subspecies lost it and gained the mind path with it. He is the whole of one side of that dispute, recorded on a body where both effects can be measured against the parent, and he has been examined three times and filed as a curiosity each time.

A heresy is disputed over whether there is a test site, and the mind path on the mortal plains is a body with the mind path open. He is the one piece of evidence in the setting that could settle it, and the dispute has gone on by arguing over him rather than by examining him, which is the reason his examinations have stayed curiosities.

A daily sitting that flattens the surface of the mind so an incoming impression has nothing to break against, the cheapest passive in the codex and almost no element. He takes it every morning for the same reason he holds the account: because a person who expects to be read should be as difficult to read as his training can make him, and this is the only such practice that costs him nothing to keep.

reference_stats.summary: Cannot be warned, cannot be found, and cannot be made to last. He cultivates nothing, he has no defence worth naming, and he is the most consequential person in his house purely by virtue of being unquotable. He is at his best in a dark room with a closed ledger and at his worst in a bright one with an examiner in it.
strengths: cannot be warned by qi, technique, curse or poison through any channel, because there is nothing in his interior for such a thing to arrive at
sees in the dark perfectly, which makes him the only member of his line who can read, check or work an unaided ledger and has become the household's undeclared auditor
holds a four-generation household account in a form that no search, raid, subpoena or seizure has ever recovered, which is the asset his entire standing rests on
is a ninety-year body whose mind path is open and completely untrained, making him the only living body in the setting in which the effect of a lost symbiont can be separated from its cause
gives off no light and does not announce himself, which makes him the least conspicuous person in any room containing his own species
weaknesses: lives about forty-six more years in a body that repairs nothing at all, and has made no arrangement that outlives him
is slight, fragile and slow, and a ninety-year deadlight is a poor thing to be cornered in
carries a household's entire solvency in his own head and has never split it, so one accident, one illness or one arrest is a total loss
has never cultivated the one path his body newly permits, so he has no technique, no resistance and nothing to trade for safety
reference_stats.combat_read: There is no fight here. He is the least dangerous person in the setting and would lose every engagement in the first exchange, because his protection is entirely passive and entirely a function of what he refuses to write down. The correct read is that nobody should be trying to fight him: the useful move is to obtain what he holds, and the only ways to do that are coercion and patience, and the first does not work on him at all while the second works only as long as he lives. Anyone who needs a household's figures tomorrow should be looking at his successor rather than at him, and that is the actual shape of the threat.
notes: The house's ledgers record income, disputes and small sums. They contain no figure that anybody would raid a building for, which is exactly the arrangement working.
He has been examined three times and each examination produced the same figure and was filed as a curiosity. Nothing in the record classifies it as a measurement.
The mineral line at his sternum has not changed in thirty-five years, and no physician in the house will discuss it, which is the only subject on which the entire house is silent.

art.palette_notes: Grey-green and cold bone, with no emission anywhere in the frame: this is the only subject on the plain who is lit entirely by his surroundings, so every frame must show what is lighting him. The single warm note is a small copper clasp at the throat, deliberately the smallest saturated value in the picture. No cast shadow and no glow of any kind; contact darkening only. Ink contours drawn fine and precise with visible small corrections, as if the line had been laid twice; wash laid in thin and cool, never filling a shape with a solid, so the underlying room always reads faintly through him.

identity.realm: None, and the none is constitutional rather than a choice: the density that makes him the most durable body in the record is the density that will not let a dantian form, so the energy ladder's floor rung is exactly the gate his construction rules out and mind cultivation is closed outright for the same reason. He tops out at seventeen and stops there every time, and he is the only body in the setting that could have watched that gate from the inside and filed what it saw.

appearance.presentation: An enormous, still, unhurried man who moves the way architecture moves when it settles. He is the largest thing most people on a working face will ever stand next to and he has been made to feel that this is a personal quality, and he has never corrected them. He is employed as a measuring device.
appearance.age: Sixty-one by the settlement's count, in a body that is not falling apart and will not be getting any more durable. He has held the same licence for thirty-four years and has been offered a share twice and refused it twice for reasons he has never stated to anybody.
appearance.build: Dense, broad and slow, with a heavier skeleton than anything else native to the mortal tier and a frame assembled to carry load rather than to move quickly. The mass is not graceful anywhere. He is built the way a retaining wall is built.
appearance.complexion: Grey-pale and slightly waxy, the complexion of stone kept near damp and then dried. It takes a bruise for weeks and fades in a colour nobody quite recognises, and he has a scatter of old lift-strains across the shoulders that never quite resolved into anything.
appearance.hair: Coarse, iron-grey, cut short and uneven by somebody else and he has stopped noticing. It grows back between shifts. There is a bald patch at the crown that he attributes to the load rather than to his age, and which is roughly correct.
appearance.eyes: Slow to focus and slow to move, grey, and set rather deep under a heavy brow. He watches a thing for a long time before he has looked at it. He is the finest sounding plate in the blind survey guild's roster and has never once been asked to use that.
appearance.palette: Ash grey, wet stone, iron oxide and undyed heavy cloth, with one band of colour that runs through every frame: the quarry company's issued orange on the lifting webbing and its strapping. He is the only saturated thing in a working face because the only saturated thing at a working face is the gear.
appearance.attire: A heavy wool coat cut to layers for a cold face and open at the neck over a strapped chest wrap, canvas trousers bound at the shin, and soft-soled boots because a hard sole on the face is how the gear is broken. The orange lifting webbing crosses his chest and runs to a hip ring, worn smooth and faded where his hands have been for thirty-four years.
appearance.marks: A hard ridge of thickened hide across the base of each shoulder and the heel of one hand, and a healed split at the outer knee that is the only place the coat has ever gone through. He treats these as a ledger of shifts and has been asked, twice, by a surgeon, to have them treated properly.
appearance.bearing: Unmoved by the ordinary business of the world. He stands the way the spoil heap stands: with no intention of being somewhere else, and with the entire strength of himself held in reserve against not being disturbed by it.

canon.role_in_story: There is exactly one job on the plains that cannot be done without being taught, and it is taught on a spoil heap by the weight moved rather than by instruction, which means the settlement's ore figure — how much spirit stone the ridge has left per unit of ground worked, published and independent of anybody's opinion — is produced by a man moving a heap in front of other men. That is him. He is the instrument. He is also, and this is the part of the arrangement that the institution has never had to think about, a body made of the same ore as the pile in front of him, which means every load he moves is moved by the same material the ledger says the ridge has left over. He is the setting's standing temptation to move the heap and its standing reason nobody dares, because a working face's entire published figure is measured in his shifts and a man who could shift it all in a season would make the figure meaningless rather than correct it. The dependency runs the wrong way: the settlement's winter depends on a number he produces, the number depends on his capacity, and his capacity is a seventeenth-realm ceiling that no amount of practice will move.
canon.first_appearance: First seen crouching at the base of the heap with both hands under a strap and not moving at all for a span long enough that the waiting apprentice took him for resting, and then standing up with the whole load and having apparently been under it the entire time.
canon.lore: The spoil heap has stood on the exhausted seam for four decades because nothing on the plains can carry it away: spatial law is unspent here, so a mine's exhaustion is not a change in the ground but a permanent addition to it, and the ground around the seam has been sterilised by the spoil nobody could move. That is why a whole profession exists and why it is not a mistake. He is the densest body native to the mortal tier, and density is a finite inherited quantity with no replenishment anywhere below the Immortal tier, because iron ore is the only dense material the tier can reach and the seam is worked out. It is also the density that will not let a dantian form, so the ladder's first real rung is the one his construction rules out and mind cultivation is closed outright for the same reason; he stops one gate short of the end of his own tier by geometry rather than by discipline, and he is the only body in the record that has stood on the inside of that gate. Nobody has ever asked him what he saw there. He cannot say. He cannot feel a dantian form, so the absence has no shape to report. The one number that matters to the settlement and the one he is employed to produce are the same number, and he produces it by spending the only resource he has, which is himself.
history: Was licensed as a heap lifter at twenty-seven, which was considered old, and discovered in his first year that the licence is not a trade certificate but a measurement certificate and that the distinction is not written anywhere on it.
Watched a shift supervisor post two younger, lighter men onto the face and then revise the published figure downward, and understood that the figure had been reporting him and not the ground.

Taught four apprentices by weight moved rather than by instruction, and has never been able to teach the second half of what he knows because it is not a thing that can be demonstrated without a gate he cannot pass.

Was offered a share in the lift twice and declined twice, and has told exactly one person that a man who owns the number is no longer the instrument and would rather be the instrument. He has since begun refusing a fifth load on the days his shoulder reads badly, which is the first refusal of his career and has been counted by four people who were not supposed to be counting.

Was asked, by an examiner with a contract to receive readings, what the seventeenth gate is like from inside, and had to answer that he does not know, because a body that cannot form a dantian has no experience of the gate failing as distinct from the gate never having been there.

personality.summary: Enormous, deliberate, and quietly certain that a measurement is worth more than an opinion, which is a belief he learned by being right too often. He presents as a reliable labourer with no opinions. He has one opinion, it is about measurement, and he has held it for thirty-four years without ever once raising his voice about it.
traits: can carry more than anything else native to his tier and can do so repeatedly and slowly, which is the whole of his professional value
cannot be warned by qi, technique or poison, because the density that makes him durable also makes him difficult to reach at all
learns a craft by watching how much of it gets done and cannot be taught a number, which has made him an excellent judge of a claim and a poor keeper of a record
transmits ground vibration better than anything else in the setting and has never once been employed for it
cannot form a dantian and therefore cannot cultivate anything at all, and has made his peace with this by never once mentioning it
mannerisms: starts a lift without apparently testing it, and is under the load before the apprentice has decided where to stand
sets his feet before he sets his grip, and does both in the same order every time
answers a question about a load by moving it rather than by describing it, which has left several people with no answer they can write down
watches a thing for a long time before looking at it, and is genuinely not aware that he does this
holds his hands out of the way when other people are working so that nobody can be injured by standing near him
motivations: wants the published figure to be a fact about the ground rather than a fact about his shifts, and does not yet know a way to ask for that without becoming the thing he declined twice
wants somebody qualified to ask him what the seventeenth gate feels like from the wrong side, so that he can stop having an answer he has not checked
wants his apprentices to be able to teach the demonstration properly and not just the lifting, and is out of ideas that do not involve the gate
wants the sterilised ground around the seam to be measured and published, because it has been nobody's business for four decades
flaws: has spent thirty-four years being a measurement and has gradually stopped distinguishing between the settlement's interests and his own capacity, which are not the same and have never agreed
answers questions about load by performing the load, which has made him extremely hard to interview and has prevented anyone writing down what he actually knows
declined a share twice on a principle and has never examined whether the principle was the reason or the refusal itself
has four decades of unrecorded observation about a ceiling nobody in the setting has bothered to examine from the inside, and has never once pushed for it to be examined
personality.voice: Very slow, very low, and made almost entirely of quantities, which he will state with the precision of somebody who has never been corrected. He does not use contractions and does not finish other people's sentences. When he does not know a thing he says so plainly and does not decorate it.
taboos: will not let a load be posted to a man who cannot take it, on any face, including his own, and has only recently started doing this about himself
will not take a share in the lift, on the grounds that an owner of the number is no longer the instrument
will not speak about the seventeenth gate as though he knows anything about it
will not be counted past what he has moved on a given day, and has never corrected anybody who has

relationships.note: A dense slow body assembled for load-bearing work, carrying more physique and stamina than anything else here and stopping at the Immortal tier because the density that makes it durable is the density that will not let a dantian form. He was born at his own ceiling and cannot cultivate anything, and the most valuable thing about him is the one his construction rules out.

A whole profession exists because spatial law is unspent and the heap has stood on the ore that is gone for four decades. He is the standing temptation to move it and the standing reason nobody dares, and his shifts are what the charter's published per-unit figure is measured in, which makes the town's number never independent of him.

The one job on the plains that cannot be done without being taught is taught on a spoil heap by the weight moved rather than by instruction. Every winter that is provisioned on a number somebody decided to believe rests on the premise that this man can still do it, and the demonstration is taught rather than hired precisely because there is no second body to call.

Spoil that has not moved in four decades has sterilised the ground around the exhausted seam, because a mine's exhaustion here is a permanent addition rather than a change. He has spent his working life on exactly that ground and is the only reason anyone has ever proposed moving it, which is why nobody has.

The only worked ground held by an institution that does not sell its output because the forge is public and its ore is accounted as spent. He is that accounting's permanent loss: a body made of the same ore as the pile, carried by himself, never returned to any forge, and the ledger's most durable entry.

The densest bodies stop one gate short of the end of their own tier, and this species is the case the published explanation was written about. He is the only body that could have observed that gate from the inside and filed what it saw, and he cannot file it, because a body that never forms a dantian has no experience of a gate failing as distinct from a gate never having been there.

reference_stats.summary: The most durable body in the setting and a poor fighter, because everything that makes him hard to hurt also makes him slow to act and impossible to hurry. He cultivates nothing and cannot. He is at his best in front of a heap with an audience and at his worst anywhere that requires a decision faster than he can reach it.
strengths: carries more than anything else native to his tier and can do it repeatedly at a pace nobody else can maintain at all
cannot be warned by qi, technique, curse or poison, so nothing that can be done to a cultivator can be done to him either
transmits ground vibration better than anything else here, which makes him the finest sounding plate in the survey guild's roster and entirely unasked for
establishes a weight by demonstrating it in front of witnesses, which is the only quality control available for a claim about load
cannot form a dantian, and so cannot be interrupted, compelled, pacified or instructed by anything that works through cultivation
weaknesses: is stopped by seventeenth realm and cannot exceed it, so no cultivation, technique or progression is available to him in any amount
is enormous and unmistakable and moves at a speed that a lighter body can simply walk around
has no defence he can improvise and no retreat that works, because nothing he owns will move quickly and nothing about him discourages an attack
produces the settlement's published ore figure with his own shifts, which means the number and his capacity have been quietly growing into the same thing for thirty-four years
reference_stats.combat_read: He is a wall and not a duellist. Nothing he throws will land quickly, and a lighter opponent who can stay away from him wins on patience rather than on damage. What he actually offers is that nothing in the cultivation ladder touches him: no qi, no technique and no compulsion reaches a body with no dantian to be reached through. So the correct read is to disengage and keep him between something and somebody else, because he does not need to be defending anything and is extremely good at occupying a corridor while other people work. Attacking him is expensive and, for a qi practitioner, close to pointless.
notes: The charter's published figure is denominated per unit of ground worked, which sounds independent of the crew and is not, because the figure is produced by his shifts.
He is licensed as a lifter, not as a practitioner, and no document in the setting classifies what he is instead.
Four decades of spoil has not moved, and he has been the reason it could not be moved in any way that the town would accept as a demonstration.

art.palette_notes: Ash grey, wet stone and iron oxide with heavy undyed wool, built as a genuinely low-saturation frame so that one band of quarry orange — the lifting webbing crossing his chest — is the only saturated value anywhere. He is a mass of greys standing in a field of greys, which is the entire visual statement of a body that is scenery. No cast shadow and a hard-edged contact shadow only where his boots meet the ground, because a diffuse shadow would make him look smaller. Ink contours drawn enormously heavy and doubled along the outer silhouette; wash laid in flat blocks with visible dry-brush edges, and the orange webbing painted last, opaque, over everything.
